source.title: Corpus of Texts in the Indus Script
source.transformations: Visual inspection of source PNG crops, source-only wider PDF rendering for rows24,25,29, and visual comparison with Finnish numerical chart cells.

source_ocr_exposure.description: The original selection locator included source-PDF OCR witness strings. It was read before crop inspection. Later work used selection-source-only.json with those fields omitted. This limits number blinding; no new recognition output or drawn-unit counts were exposed.

conventions.unit_order: Visual left-to-right in the upright source drawing.
conventions.classification_literal: Exactly five positions, retaining spaces; null only if visually unreadable.
conventions.strict_candidate_codes: Finnish lower chart codes preserving source underlining, chart numeric ambiguities and unresolved visually identical code choices.
conventions.shape_only_candidate_codes: The same outline candidates with corresponding underlined/plain chart variants added where visually supported; outline differences are retained.
conventions.chart_references: PDF page is one-based; chart column and row are zero-based.
conventions.crop_correct: True requires complete target drawing bodies and uncertainty underlines, without neighbouring-row ink or printed-margin ink in glyph_pdf_box.
conventions.drawn_unit_count: Modern printed drawing units, including auxiliary damage graphics. It is not an original archaeological sign count.
conventions.original_sign_count: Left null because original physical line/side counts are not reconstructed.
conventions.visible_gaps_after_unit_indices_ltr_0bas: Observed larger horizontal gaps only; physical boundaries remain unresolved.
conventions.qualitative_confidence: Visual judgment, not a calibrated probability.
